catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class binds the four-fin eeuv_sim_interfaces/Flippers oscillation publication. cap.motion.joint_velocity.v1 is a bounded-duration joint-velocity invoke that returns applied/velocities and binds robot.arm or motion.axis; Flippers is a fire-and-forget ROS topic publication with four per-fin amplitude, frequency, zero-direction and phase-offset fields and no acknowledgement. The extension preserves the upstream message shape and makes the publication-only contract explicit.

No catalogue class observes a gazebo_msgs/EntityState sample. cap.sensing.read.v1 is a named-channel read with an open values object, not the EntityState name/pose/twist/reference_frame document; cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.step.v1 act on a world and do not carry this observation.
No catalogue class carries eeuv_sim_interfaces/FlippersFeedbacks. cap.motion.joint_velocity.v1 is an actuation command, not a passive four-named-fin position, velocity and acceleration observation.

No catalogue class binds an unacknowledged std_msgs/Bool reset publication. cap.world.reset.v1 is a seeded scenario reset with an observation/seed output, while /ucat/reset carries only data=true and returns no observation or acknowledgement.

The fin timer keeps running (moveFins.py:137). Gazebo is a visualiser here; pausing it would not stop the free-running Python timer at AUVMotion.py:97.

SOURCE. /ucat/state is gazebo_msgs/msg/EntityState and the published document has no header. The publisher is create_publisher(EntityState, "/ucat/state", 10) at AUVMotion.py:113, so freshness is arrival, history durability volatile cited at that line, min_interval_ms 5. Twist is filled at AUVMotion.py:398-403. Predicate: norm_max body_linear (m/s) and body_angular (rad/s), both Limit.operator_required. consecutive 3, min_span_ms 19, max_gap_ms 500, confirm_within_ms 1500, estop_latency_ms 2500. fixtures/estop-confirmation.json holds fake placeholders only. The shipped timer is dt/fast_forward with dt 0.01 (AUVMotion.py:75) and fast_forward 1.0 (eeuv_sim/data/rl_setting/rl_setting.yaml:2), so the period is 10 ms. Three counted samples span two periods, and that span in milliseconds lands just under 20, so min_span_ms is 19. A bound of 20 rejects the shipped period. A fast_forward above 1 shortens the span below 19 ms and the stop fails closed unless the operator lowers min_span_ms. A fast_forward above 2 also publishes faster than min_interval_ms 5 and fails closed. A replay spaced at or above 5 ms is not distinguished from live samples.
